plugin.name: Arcade Machine
plugin.description: Three office games in your IDE: Turkish Wordle, Higher / Lower and live drawing rooms. Connect to your office's Arcade Machine LAN server for shared daily challenges and live leaderboards.
plugin.change-notes: Çiz & Bil now shows Play Again after a match. The room host can start another game with the same players; canvas and room scores reset while each completed match contributes once to the leaderboards. Play Again requires Arcade server 0.3.2; existing games still work with server 0.3.0.
